disagg.heading: Breakdowns
disagg.warnTag: Read this before using these figures
disagg.warnBody: No {municipality} form collects refugee status or disability. Fields for both were built onto the completion and registration forms on 24 August 2026 and removed the same day; nothing has asked since. Every participant entered through a real form therefore appears as “not recorded” on those two breakdowns, and will keep doing so until the forms ask.
disagg.warnSeed: The refugee and disability values shown below come from seeded demonstration records only. They are not a finding about anyone. Refugee disaggregation is the reason this Action Plan exists, so this gap is open question OQ-12 and it is the Coordinator's to close — it is a form change and may need a data-protection review.

F0.1.title: Promotional actions
F0.1.hint: One record per action. The indicator counts these, so a campaign run twice is two records.

G0.3.title: Case studies
G0.3.hint: One record per documented case study. The summary and the change evidenced both go into the donor return.

manual.elsewhereIntro: These are not on this screen on purpose. Two of them count distinct people and one counts distinct partners, so a typed total could double-count and could never be corrected afterwards — the identities would not have been captured. The other two hang off a record you have to choose first.

elsewhere.B1.2: Farmers reaching office services — counts distinct people, so each visit is logged against a national ID in the coordination office module.
elsewhere.D0.1: Producers guided on food safety and licensing — counts distinct people, so each session is logged against a national ID in the guidance log.
elsewhere.C1.3: Advisory mentorship sessions — counts sessions, and each one belongs to a producer's initiative, so it is recorded against that initiative rather than typed as a total here.
elsewhere.D0.2: Training sessions on food processing — counted from sessions marked as delivered, so it moves when you record delivery.
elsewhere.G0.4: Partners contributing to the plan — counts distinct partners with a recorded contribution, so each contribution is logged against a partnership in the partner's record.
